slices.name: Terraform foundation: DynamoDB, S3, IAM
slices.description: Provision core AWS infrastructure. Already complete.

slices.name: A visitor can see a vendor page with product catalogue
slices.description: Tenant types (including products, operational schedule, delivery settings), DynamoDB getTenantBySlug, Renderer Lambda (SSR HTML with inline CSS, product catalogue with prices, add-to-cart UI, operational hours, delivery/takeout info, SEO, JSON-LD), Terraform for Lambda + API Gateway + CloudFront, seed vendor data with products, deploy to staging, verify page loads with products visible.

slices.name: A visitor can purchase products and receive a confirmation
slices.description: Cart (client-side), checkout flow (takeout vs delivery with vendor-set fee, delivery date/time from vendor's operational schedule), Stripe Connect payment, order record in DynamoDB, confirmation emails to both customer (receipt) and vendor (order notification with items, delivery notes, time). API handlers: create Stripe checkout session, Stripe webhook for payment confirmation. Terraform for Stripe webhook Lambda. Seed vendor Stripe account ID. Deploy, verify full purchase flow.
boundaries: Browser -> API Gateway -> API Lambda -> Stripe + DynamoDB + SES

slices.name: A visitor can submit a quote request
slices.description: QuoteRequest types, createQuoteRequest DB helper, API Lambda quote submission handler, SES email notification to vendor, rate limiting. Deploy, verify quote submission from vendor page.
enables: Visitor can request custom event catering
boundaries: Browser -> API Gateway -> API Lambda -> DynamoDB + SES

slices.name: A vendor can log in and see their dashboard
slices.description: Session and MagicLink types, DB helpers, Auth Lambda (request/verify/logout), Admin SPA scaffold (React + Vite + routing + login + protected routes), deploy admin SPA to S3 + CloudFront /admin/*, verify full magic link login flow.
boundaries: Browser -> Admin SPA -> Auth Lambda -> DynamoDB + SES

slices.name: A vendor can manage their page, products, and schedule
slices.description: Vendor update handler, photo upload (presigned S3 URLs), cache invalidator Lambda, admin profile page (name, photos, story, social links), product CRUD (add/edit/delete/reorder), operational schedule (dates, times), delivery settings (fee, enabled/disabled), deploy and verify edits reflect on public page.
boundaries: Admin SPA -> API Lambda -> DynamoDB + S3 + CloudFront

slices.name: A vendor can view orders and manage customers
slices.description: Order list in admin (paginated, sorted newest first, filterable by status), order detail view (items, delivery info, customer, payment status), customer list derived from orders (name, email, total spent, order count, last order), send email to customer, mark orders fulfilled. Deploy, verify.
boundaries: Admin SPA -> API Lambda -> DynamoDB + SES

slices.name: A vendor can view and manage their quote requests
slices.description: Quote request list in admin (paginated, read/unread, expand details, mark as read, unread count in nav), separate from orders. Deploy, verify.

slices.name: A vendor can manage their Stripe account and market calendar
slices.description: Stripe Connect onboarding flow (vendor connects bank account), Stripe dashboard link for payout management, market calendar page in admin (add/edit/delete market dates). Deploy, verify.
boundaries: Admin SPA -> API Lambda -> Stripe + DynamoDB

slices.name: SEO + sitemap + production deploy
slices.description: Sitemap Lambda (scan tenants, generate XML, write to S3, daily schedule), deploy everything to production, full end-to-end validation.
